# Default Button Controls

Source: [2130](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/2130); edited 2024-04-13. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-2130-n1"></a>

- Catalog maps Workshop buttons to default PC/PlayStation/Xbox/Switch controls; PC entries include primary left mouse, secondary right mouse, Ability 1 Shift, Ability 2 E, ultimate Q, jump Space, crouch Ctrl, melee V, reload R.

<a id="wiki-2130-n2"></a>

- Controller table contains trigger/bumper/face-button equivalents and stick-click melee; image alt text carries the usable offline labels.

Data: [normalized factual tables](../tables/2130.md).

Source limitations:

- April 2024 default mappings are not user remappings or hero-specific controls.

- Interact row repeats generic 'Interact' alt text and cannot determine physical bindings from text alone.

- Xbox alt text incorrectly uses PlayStation R1/R2/L1/L2 labels; Ability 1/2 bumper assignments require checking rather than trusting copied text.

- Images not downloaded or visually verified; complete HTML and alt text read.

Offline scope: Image files omitted; their available alternative-text labels are preserved in the normalized binding table, with ambiguous console and Interact cells marked.
